relationshipToFrozenBatch: Follow-up discovered while reviewing public routes affected by the frozen ten. It does not replace any selected site. Logan Creek remains withheld because its Pender terminal is unresolved.

sites.method: Use current Nebraska Game and Parks ArcGIS point geometry and the published Paddle_Lat/Paddle_Long. Geometry and coordinate attributes agree to under a foot; 100 feet is a conservative reviewer estimate, not an agency accuracy statement. Aerial imagery and NHD flowline distance provide secondary context, not permission.
